visual.titulo: Spain: share of jobs by sector

turnos.t: Where do people in Spain actually work today?

Mostly in services. In 1991 the tertiary sector had about fifty-seven percent of jobs. By 2023, seventy-six and a half. Industry fell from thirty-two percent to twenty: from one job in three to one in five.
Structural change. Rising incomes mean people spend more on services. Technology means farms and factories need fewer workers. And globalisation moves some manufacturing to lower-cost countries.
